messages:
Ethan B: Hey all — first day! Hit a weird one: clicked the Okta invite and got 'external identity conflict: OAuth provider linked' (never signed up before). Also tried to enroll a passkey and the browser says 'attestation not allowed'. 1Password invite missing. Who should I nudge?

Kai (IT): Welcome Ethan! That OAuth conflict usually happens if you used GitHub SSO earlier for an internal tool and Okta sees a matching email tied to the GitHub identity provider. Can you confirm the invite email and whether you previously used GitHub to log into any Redwood apps?

Ethan B: Invite => ethan.b@redwood.dev. I did sign into the internal Dev CI dashboard with GitHub last month (personal GH account). Could that have left a linked identity?

Kai (IT): Yes — Okta's account linking may have created a profile tied to the GitHub IdP. I can unlink the external provider or merge the accounts. Quick options: 1) I unlink the GitHub provider stub and reissue the invite, or 2) if you prefer we can link your GitHub account to the new Okta profile (less friction later). Which do you want?

Ethan B: Unlinking is fine. Also the passkey attestation error — devtools shows: `DOMException: NotAllowedError: Attestation format not permitted by policy` when trying to create credential in Chrome.

Kai (IT): Got it. I'll remove the GitHub stub and push a fresh invite to your email. Regarding attestation: our Okta policy currently blocks enterprise attestation formats for BYO devices; that error often appears if the authenticator is trying to send full attestation. Try using the Okta Verify mobile passkey flow (it uses a different attestation path). I'll open IT-57720 and send a one-time magic link to finish setup if needed.

infra-bot: [automated] Ticket IT-57720 created  "Okta external-idp collision + passkey attestation error for ethan.b@redwood.dev". Assigned to Kai (IT). ETA 2h.

Lina - People Ops: Ethan — welcome! I've added you to new-hires-temp so you get calendars/docs while IT sorts SSO. I also requested a 1Password seat (PL-1299) and escalated it; vendor says it should appear shortly. Need any repo access now or later?

Ethan B: Docs + calendar for now. Thanks for the quick help.

Kai (IT): Done: removed the GitHub-linked stub and resent invite to ethan.b@redwood.dev. Also DM'd you a magic link that bypasses the attestation gate (12h expiry). Try sign-in in an incognito window and enroll via Okta Verify mobile if the browser still errors.

Ethan B: New invite came through. Mobile Okta Verify enrollment worked and I can sign in. 1Password invite popped in too  accepted. All green, thanks!

Lina - People Ops: Awesome — welcome aboard Ethan! :tada: If you want to later link your GitHub account to SSO or set a YubiKey, ping IT and we'll help switch factors.
